name: controlid-facial-emulator
description: A plug-and-play Docker emulator of the Control-iD facial access control reader's HTTP (.fcgi) API, push/webhook mechanism, and web control panel.

scripts.lint: npm run lint -w api && npm run lint -w web
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w api && npm run lint:fix -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
